sample_unit: patient information documents (carpal tunnel release consent information)

links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid readability grade of ChatGPT vs EIDO patient information for carpal tunnel release
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid score 12.3 for ChatGPT vs 7.5 for EIDO, indicating more complex reading age for ChatGPT information.
links.quote: Flesch-Kincaid readability scoring was 12.3 for ChatGPT and 7.5 for EIDO, suggesting a more complex reading age for the ChatGPT information.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality and readability of ChatGPT-generated patient consent information compared to standard leaflets without testing an operational guardrail or deployment practice.
